mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months, indicating a rapidly tightening labor market, will lead to wage inflation and reduced corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops >0.5pp in 3mo but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 1pp year-over-year, it signals a supply-side slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by rising unemployment.
failure_condition: Y/Y INDPRO growth slows by >1pp and UNRATE is rising, but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher borrowing costs reduce investment and consumption.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 3% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts, as measured by the HOUST series, signal increased residential investment and consumer confidence, which will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises MoM but SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 0.5% year-over-year, it signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y PAYEMS growth slows by >0.5pp but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in the consumer price index (CPI), rising more than 0.5% month-over-month, signals an inflation scare that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as investors reassess risk tolerance.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL spikes >0.5pp MoM but SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate loans (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% year-over-year, it signals increased borrowing and spending on housing that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially in the early stages of an economic expansion.
failure_condition: Y/Y RSAFS growth > 1% but SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of instances.
